## 📊 Market Analysis: GoMeet PWA

### Executive Summary
The global online dating market is worth **$9.85–$11.61 billion in 2025**, growing at 7–11% CAGR, while the broader PWA market is expanding at **18.98% CAGR**. No major dating app has shipped a true installable PWA — GoMeet can own that space with ~95% code reuse from its existing Flutter codebase.

### Competitive Landscape

| Competitor | Web Presence | True PWA? |
|------------|-------------|-----------|
| **Tinder** | Full web app at tinder.com (since 2017), desktop-optimised | ❌ No manifest/service worker |
| **Bumble** | Responsive web app | ❌ No installable PWA |
| **Hinge** | Limited web app, poor desktop UX | ❌ No PWA |
| **OkCupid** | Robust desktop web (longest running) | ❌ No PWA |
| **Badoo** | Responsive web, partial PWA features | ❌ No dedicated PWA shell |

**🎯 Key Gap: No major dating app is a true installable PWA with offline support. GoMeet can own this positioning.**

---

### Recommended USP
> **"Dating without the download."** — Open a link, swipe, match, and chat in your browser. Install in seconds for a full app experience on any device.

---

### Top Recommendations
1. **Market the PWA install as a feature** — in-app prompts, referral flows, web-first landing page
2. **Hit Lighthouse PWA ≥ 90** from day one to make the "first installable dating PWA" claim credible
3. **Prioritise the deep-link referral loop** — share profile → open in browser → instant sign-up → return to profile (biggest competitive differentiator)
4. **Target desktop users** with web-first ads (Google, LinkedIn) pointing directly to the PWA URL
5. **Track PWA install rate** as a core v1 KPI
6. **Plan v2 premium on web** before v1 launches — every week of delay is lost revenue
